subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should primary-agent task completion close run-owned temporary browser tabs by default, and which user actions should preserve a tab?
rationale: Current main intentionally keeps active primary-session tabs reusable, so changing the default needs maintainer intent for the terminal event, run-owned marker, and preservation contract.

options.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
options.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not foregrounded, pinned, or explicitly requested to be kept.

options.title: Keep reusable primary tabs
options.body: Treat idle/cap cleanup plus reset cleanup as the supported model and decline task-end closing if it is too surprising.

options.title: Opt-in strict cleanup
options.body: Preserve current behavior by default while adding a documented strict cleanup mode after the ownership model is defined.

recommendation.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
recommendation.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not foregrounded, pinned, or explicitly requested to be kept.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history in the idle primary-tab cleanup and peer-scoped reset cleanup paths this decision would extend.
